outcome: A short-lived token can be issued, checked, and taken away before it expires.

acceptance_criteria.text: A freshly minted token is live and an expired one is not.

expected_verification.assertion: a token is live before its expiry and not after

acceptance_criteria.text: A token cannot be predicted from other tokens, and a revoked token stops working immediately.

expected_verification.assertion: tokens are drawn from a cryptographic source, and a revoked token is not live

data_impact: Tokens are minted and checked in memory.
security_impact: A predictable bearer token is an authentication bypass; a revocation that does not take effect is one that did not happen.
